summary: Cleanup helper: frees a single resource pointer at offset 8 through FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null, then, when the array pointer at offset 16 is non-null, reads the element count from the allocation length header located 4 bytes before the array pointer, iterates backward through 24-byte elements calling ShortComputation_d4d0 on each (destructor), and finally frees the allocation (starting at the length header) via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Returns the single-free result when no array is present.

local_names.result: first FreeWrapper_7bcf result (resource path) or zero (array-only path), returned on early exits
local_names.v3: array pointer read from offset 16; element data region, length header at v3 - 4
local_names.v5: allocation base for the array (v3 - 4, the length header), freed after the destructor loop
local_names.v4: element count read from the length header at v3 - 4
local_names.v8: running backward cursor over the 24-byte elements, starting at v3 + 8 * (3 * v4)

operations.description: Read the single resource pointer stored at offset 8
Guard on the resource pointer at offset 8: when non-null, free it directly via FreeWrapper_7bcf
Read the array pointer stored at offset 16 into v3
Guard on the array pointer at offset 16: when null, skip the destructor loop and array free, returning the resource-path result
Read the element count v4 from the length header at v3 - 4 and compute the end cursor v8 = v3 + 8 * (3 * v4), i.e. v3 + 24 * v4 (24 bytes per element)
Iterate backward from the end cursor over the 24-byte elements, calling ShortComputation_d4d0 on each (destructor), until all v4 elements are visited
Free the array allocation (base v5 = v3 - 4, the length header) via FreeWrapper_7bcf
Return the resource-path FreeWrapper_7bcf result on early exits; the array path returns the array free result
